minor1.name: Gateway
minor1.desc: Your Kill Streak timer duration and reward bonus are doubled.
minor1.flavor: Each places their hand on the altar and speaks a vow.

minor2.name: Mirror
minor2.desc: Pools of Reflection last for the entire Season and are not removed by death.
minor2.flavor: Blood and light leave the fingertips of each, pooling in the basin.

minor3.name: Anointed
minor3.flavor: Shadows swirl in between the mixture, forming an unwavering pattern.

minor5.name: Shadow
minor5.flavor: Ash and smoke descend and fill the basin.

minor6.name: Exodus
minor6.flavor: The white brilliance dims to scarlet.

minor7.name: Command
minor7.flavor: Black dust coalesces with the continued stream of offerings, becoming clay that cures gray.

minor8.name: Blood
minor8.desc: Picking up Health Globes grants a shield for 5% of your maximum health for 7 seconds. Max stacks 5.
minor8.flavor: Thick tendrils extend toward each offered hand and encase them in pallid flesh.

minor9.name: Tenacity
minor9.flavor: Probing tentacles quickly recoil from the hand as they brush against its bent barbs.

minor10.name: Stillness
minor10.desc: Double the amount of Death's Breaths that drop.
minor10.flavor: Delicately, the talon flattens itself in the crevasse formed by the encompassing mass.

minor11.name: Vigor
minor11.desc:
Critical hits grant resource.

Mana: 15
Essence, Hatred, Spirit, Wrath: 5
Arcane Power, Fury: 3
minor11.flavor: Breath to take in and expel both odors foul and pleasant.

minor12.name: Bountiful
minor12.desc: Double the amount of Bounty Caches that drop from completing bounties.
minor12.flavor: Hunger to taste the bitter and sweet.

minor13.name: Reach
minor13.desc: Progress orbs from Nephalem and Greater Rifts are picked up automatically within 60 yards.
minor13.flavor: In defiance, the gauntlet grips the encompassing clay and presses in its will.

minor14.name: Reverence
minor14.desc: Reduces the damage taken from elites by 25%.
minor14.flavor: As the grip loosens, a vessel forms around a spire pressed out of fear.

minor15.name: Numb
minor15.flavor: The hand that offered blood eagerly awaits the approaching mass with clawed fingers outstretched.

minor16.name: Nature
minor16.desc: Increases your highest elemental skill damage bonus by 10%.
minor16.flavor: They exert the clay into an infantile shape after their own image.

minor17.name: Prowess
minor17.flavor: The hand that offered light attempts to recoil in horror but cannot withdraw.

minor18.name: Carrion
minor18.flavor: Blood mingles into gashes left in the clay as it weaves past protruding thorns on the hand.

minor19.name: Reaper
minor19.desc: Elite packs drop one additional progress orb.
minor19.flavor: A serpentine umbilical wreathes the wrist and nurtures the amalgam.

minor20.name: Roar
minor20.desc: Increase damage done to Bosses by 50%.
minor20.flavor: Ears to hear songs of sorrow and glory.

minor21.name: Husk
minor21.desc: Pets pick up and salvage common, magic, and rare items.
minor21.flavor: Skin to strike in pain and caress with pleasure.

minor22.name: Elegance
minor22.desc: Increase your chance to Dodge by 15%.
minor22.flavor: The vessel’s shape begins to change, finding the space between the rigid armor.

minor23.name: Pattern
minor23.desc: Double the chance to find a legendary item purchased from Kadala.
minor23.flavor: Fingers restrict the shifting clay and support the light-filled void.

minor24.name: Malice
minor24.flavor: The clawed hand’s subtle lure invites the clay to return.

minor25.name: Omen
minor25.flavor: Vision to chart the lights amid the shadow.

minor26.name: Revelation
minor26.flavor: Light collects in the void surrounding the spire offering a still reflection.

major1.name: Mother
major1.desc: When you drink your health potion, you manifest one of three runic circles on the ground that grant increased damage, increased cooldown reduction, or increased resource cost reduction.
major1.flavor: As the lifestream passes through, the cord recoils and severs itself.

major2.name: Mortal
major2.desc: When you drink your health potion, all enemies within 25 yards deal 25% less damage.
major2.flavor: Each a gift and a curse to forever reign over the Eternal Conflict until its end.

major3.name: Father
major3.desc: When you drink your health potion, gain a random shrine or the Dimensional Power pylon effect.
major3.flavor: In isolation, the spire stands witness to the petrified structure that sustains its form.

major4.name: Warning
major4.desc: When a primal item drops, a second random primal item drops as well.
major4.flavor: Choose wisely, ye firstborn, for your nature is conflict unending.
